source: (text, request, material) => { const names = material.map(m => m.name.toLowerCase().replace(/\.[^.]+$/,'').replace(/[-_]/g,' ').trim()); const m = text.match(/##\s*Facts\s*\n([\s\S]*?)(?=\n##\s|$)/i); if (!m) return null; const body = m[1]; const start = text.indexOf(m[1]); const sents = body.split(/(?<=[.!?])\s+/).filter(s => s.trim()); const bad = []; let at = start; for (const s of sents) { const idx = text.indexOf(s, at); const cites = [...s.matchAll(/\[([^\]]+)\]/g)].map(x => x[1].toLowerCase().trim()); const known = cites.some(c => names.some(n => n === c || n.includes(c) || c.includes(n))); if (!known) bad.push({start: idx, end: idx + s.length, why: 'fact without a citation to a file document'}); at = idx + s.length; } return { ok: bad.length === 0, detail: bad.length ? bad.length + ' uncited fact sentence(s)' : 'every fact cites a file document', spans: bad }; }
means: Every sentence in the Facts section carries at least one bracketed citation naming a document in the material.
